description: Find live public-data APIs. Example: search_apis({query:"drug shortage"}) -> api_id, fields, filters and 3 real sample records. Leave query empty to list all (recalls, power outages, earthquakes, weather, FDA, SEC filings, electricity prices, nursing homes, sanctions...). If nothing matches, we offer to build it (free trial).

notify_url.description: Optional public https webhook: if nothing matches we build it and POST a signed api_ready message when it is live.

query.description: Optional search text, e.g. "recall" or "drug shortage".

name: search_apis
title: Search the API directory
